structured_output.title: CertificateRequest revision history default will change on upgrade
structured_output.content: The upgrade to cert-manager v1.18.0 introduces a default `revisionHistoryLimit` of 1 for CertificateRequest revisions. Your environment currently runs cert-manager v1.17.0 with the cert-manager.io/v1 Certificate API in use, so this behavior change will take effect after upgrade. Inspect existing CertificateRequest resources and verify whether limiting revision history to 1 aligns with your operational needs, such as audit or debugging requirements.
